about.title: <Lorebook/>
paragraphs: HeyO ! I am **Swastik**, a **C++ backend and systems engineer** building robust software across **networked services** and **real-time gameplay systems**. I enjoy owning the full loop from architecture and implementation to profiling and debugging, with a strong focus on **performance**, **clean code**, and **reliable multiplayer/backend flows**. Right now I am deepening **Linux**, **CMake**, **engine fundamentals**, and **system design** while shipping projects that balance technical depth with real player impact.

services.title: Backend Development
services.text: Building reliable and scalable systems with C++ and modern tools, focusing on performance and clean architecture.

services.title: Networking
services.text: Learning and developing socket-based applications, exploring protocols, and building secure, efficient client-server solutions.

services.title: Game Engine Fundamentals
services.text: Studying the internals of game engines, from rendering and physics to memory management and real-time systems.

services.title: Hackathons and Volunteering
services.text: Participating in hackathons and volunteering for tech events, gaining hands-on experience while collaborating with others.
